title: Running Total
instructions:
Complete the `runningTotal` function. It takes a `List<Int>` called `scores` and returns a new `List<Int>` where each element is the sum of all elements up to and including that position.

For example, `runningTotal(listOf(10, 20, 30))` should return `[10, 30, 60]`.
hint: Create a mutable list for the result and a variable to track the running sum. Loop through the scores, add each one to the sum, and add the sum to the result list.
